savings.reason: The full alternate original shows only Council-dependent advice, support, information, travel and FACA administration (with Congress reporting excepted); accrued travel reimbursement may survive. Held revoker has no target-specific savings continuing those functions. Source-selection/page reconciliation is still required before a complete frozen claim can be approved.

sheet.research_rationale: Independent review finds a real frozen original-selection/inventory blocker, despite the selected source's requires_page_check=false and dossier missing=[] fields. The full alternate original cited by own-terms evidence was then read: section 3(d) requires departments/agencies to provide information requested for Council functions; section 4(a) delegates Council-specific FACA functions to the ONDCP Director and excepts Congress reporting; section 4(b) has the 24-month sunset. These are Council-dependent commands, not an identified independent program. EO12756 section 1 expressly continues the Council until November 13, 1993, superseding the original November 13, 1991 candidate, and section 2 merely raises section 1(a)'s membership cap 30 to 35. EO12869 section 4(d) expressly revokes EO12696 effective September 30, 1993 by section 6, before the extension's end. The likely final date is not promoted because selected-original spans cannot supply a complete frozen inventory and the alternate requires official page inspection.
unresolved_material_gaps: Selected frozen ORIGINAL:EO:12696 recheck text stops after section 3(c) at the page-12 FR Doc line. The fully read alternate text jobs/fr-originals/output/texts/EO_12696.txt, cited by frozen own-terms evidence, holds section 3(d), section 4(a) and section 4(b) outside this selected original. The existing derive_inventory interface may only select spans inside the selected original, so it cannot reconstruct those absent clauses against the exact frozen dossier.

Inspect official original pages 54 FR 47507-47508 (PDF pages 11-12) to satisfy the alternate representation's requires_page_check=true, reconcile the erroneous truncated recheck selection, and issue a corrected separately frozen dossier. The alternate full OCR is held; this is not evidence exhaustion or a claim that no text exists.
